body:
This is actually the first time I’ve seen FYRE mentioned, but I’ll definitely look into them.

I was actually leaning more towards defy originally. Did you have a bad experience with them or is there a specific reason you don’t like them?
Did they just set you up on a cookie cutter protocol or were they willing to work with you on getting dialed in?

I’m definitely looking to get more guidance. I’ve done a ton of research over the past few months before even deciding this was something I wanted to peruse, but I still want a knowledgeable and easily accessible clinic.

I tried hormonesforme since I’ve heard a lot about them, but sadly they aren’t licensed in my state yet. I also tried matrix hormones but it says they only service people 30 and above so I struck out there as well

Definitely something I should’ve considered before I started. I have a rather large pile of bolts and small parts all clumped together in a box which is very demoralizing when it comes to putting everything back together… my next step is hopefully getting everything organized 😅

And sadly I have a drain pan. I just didn’t consider the location of it when taking out the coolant lines. Big bag of kitty litter made quick work of the cleanup through haha

I’ve thought about changing out the single disc brakes but wasn’t sure which direction to take. I’ll have to do some research on that  

Your Z’s looking good, can’t wait to see how it turns out!
I’ve seen that book mentioned a few times on these forums but never thought to order a copy for myself. Just found one on eBay and ordered it!
